label: TP
reason: User input retrieved via getParameterNames() flows through a chain of transformations (StringBuilder manipulation, Base64 encode/decode, substring, split) to become the argument passed to ThingFactory.createThing(). The returned string becomes input for encryption, then gets converted back to a String and passed to ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML(), which directly concatenates into the HTTP response. Although obfuscation attempts exist, they do not prevent user-controlled data from reaching the XSS sink.

evidence.note: User input flows from getParameterNames through transformations to encodeForHTML sink
